content: <thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈267.1867 Da. The relative intensity of the M+1 peak (~20 % of the base peak) corresponds to roughly 18 carbon atoms (≈1.1 % × 18 ≈ 20 %). A formula that fits both the exact mass and the carbon count is C₁₈H₁₉O₂ (monoisotopic mass = 267.1385 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C18H19O2.
